note: Round-22 parser fixes (vespera_macro): an axum wrapper path qualified by an external root (axum::response::Redirect, vespera::axum::...) is no longer taken for a same-named crate type, and a crate type named like a response part (Extension, TypedHeader) keeps its body; aliases nested in a Result or a tuple response position are expanded; a flattened non-string query field is documented as a string; request views of a flattened enum followed by a map, and of a generic newtype over a map, are classified correctly; an input resolves to its own component; a tuple struct's skipped Option position documents only its Some value; polymorphic recursion of generic instances is capped per top-level type; a Header binding named after a reserved header is not documented.
